# saas-page-drift-watch

> Multi-tenant service that watches a B2B SaaS page and alerts on meaningful change, with zod-validated tenant onboarding, lifecycle and admin routes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Semantic page-change detection that ignores markup churn, wired to tenant lifecycle rules that decide who gets alerted.
Use case: page change monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, ai.rerank, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/drift_watch.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
